title: Current state of LLM Risks and AI Guardrails
measurement_description: The paper discusses the measurement of bias in LLMs across various categories, including professions and religion, using specific benchmarks.
findings: The paper identifies bias related to religion as a potential risk in LLMs and notes that the StereoSet benchmark is used to measure such biases in tasks like sentiment analysis and question answering.
